verdict.rationale: Trello's own docs list a built-in capability to "Use AI to help write or edit content" (trello-docs-32), so there is an in-product AI assistant, but the evidence covers only content writing and editing. The MCP server (trello-docs-6) is for connecting external AI tools, and automation (trello-docs-3) is not an AI assistant, so neither counts here. missing for 10: evidence that the built-in AI can take on and carry out delegated tasks (creating or organizing cards, running workflows), detailed first-party docs on the assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
